maya Quick ping: Vendor Z has 3 spare H100s in asia-southeast1 for ~24h starting tomorrow morning. Can we grab for a short latency sweep? Low QPS, ephemeral. Need infra+billing thumbs. @diego ok with asia-southeast1? :wave:
diego Sounds fine. Pool: dev-latency-checks? No mounts?
maya Correct, dev-latency-checks, ephemeral, S3 artifacts only. No mounts.
procure-bot Vendor Z ETA: ~14-18h. Ticket ZV-5567. PO required if spend > $1,200.
len I can open infra PR. Will prefer single AZ asia-southeast1-a to reduce variance and set nodeStartupTimeout=5m.
procure-bot Please include cost center and NTE amount in PR for finance to queue PO.
maya Cost center cc-620. Estimate: 3 GPUs * 6h + 2h buffer = 20 GPU-hours. Rate ~$40/hr => request cap $1k. Approver: @diego.
diego Approved up to $1k if run auto-terminates at 10h and telemetry to `latency/dev` is enabled. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot Reminder: include `az=asia-southeast1-a` label, healthcheck that fails fast on node joining >5m, and fallback to local l40s pool if vendor cancels.
ops Note: post-run, drop a one-line in #incidents if p95 regresses >30% so SRE can snapshot traces.
maya I'll add smoke test + telemetry flags and open PR now. Will update with PR link and PO form once submitted. Thanks! :rocket:
